name: tensorViz
summary: Open-source PyTorch model visualiser that runs one real forward pass and turns it into an interactive graph with measured tensor shapes that coding agents can inspect.
description: Open-source PyTorch model visualiser that runs one real forward pass and turns it into an interactive graph with measured tensor shapes that coding agents can inspect.

pricing.details: Free, MIT licence. No paid plan and no AI key required.
pricing.label: Free

features: Runs one real forward pass on a PyTorch nn.Module and turns it into an interactive graph with measured tensor shapes
Coding agents can inspect the graph; no model export or ONNX conversion is required, and no AI key is needed
Free, MIT licence. This is not the PyPI package of a similar name — as stated on the official site
